summary.text: Soft Gold Crashing Pillar is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's killer move. Golden light forms crashing pillars meant to counter Reverse Flow Protection Seal.

claims.text: After a clash involving reverse flow protection seal and rank nine light Gu, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable names soft gold crashing pillar and says he designed it to counter that seal. Fang Yuan agrees that the move can conceal its strength and unleash a mystical collision force on reverse flow protection seal to penetrate Reverse Flow River and interrupt the seal’s operation. He also says the move has not been completed yet, otherwise it would not have been resolved so easily. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable treats that incompleteness as a pity.

Inside Heavenly Court, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable activates the immortal killer move Soft Gold Crashing Pillar. Golden light flows into tens of crashing pillars that slam into Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s star fog. The impact makes the fog’s luck shake intensely. Everything in heaven and earth contains luck, and attacking that luck starts to disrupt the fog’s operations. He had used the move on Fang Yuan before while it was incomplete. Now it is completed, yet under Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s control in Heavenly Court the star fog still endures.
